title: Product-description reviewer protected-access verification
summary: A production denial probe, source retrieval, management inventory, and complete reviewer regression set verify that the new administrative endpoint is active, fail-closed, and contract-bound.

checks.name: Unauthenticated denial
checks.detail: A production inspect request without the dedicated administrator credential returned HTTP 403 before any protected product data was returned.

checks.name: Response hardening
checks.detail: The denial response was non-cacheable, declared nosniff protection, and exposed only the reviewed contract headers.

checks.name: One-product workflow
checks.detail: The retrieved handler accepts exactly one governed product identifier and contains no batch approval or bulk publication path.

checks.name: Reviewer regression tests
checks.detail: The protected reviewer, administrator client, body-free receipt, immutable audit workflow, optimistic locking, and description-governance tests all passed.

checks.name: Positive path gate retained
checks.detail: The production positive-path inspection remains intentionally unexecuted without the protected administrator credential and controlled product identity; no approval is inferred from this technical record.
